description: This file defines a final class DoctrineQuery that extends Doctrine's AbstractQuery class. It provides stub implementations for getSQL() and _doExecute() methods that currently throw exceptions indicating they are not implemented. The class is part of the OrangeHRM ORM namespace and seems to serve as a custom extension or placeholder for Doctrine ORM functionalities within the OrangeHRM project.

classes.name: DoctrineQuery
classes.description: A final class extending Doctrine's AbstractQuery, providing stub methods for getSQL and _doExecute that currently throw 'Not implement' exceptions.
